name: survey-paper
title: Draft survey evidence paper
for_each: select id,code from surveys order by code

sections.title: Recorded observations
sections.sql: select code,scientific_name,count,identification,sensitive,evidence_ref from observations where survey_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Checks requiring resolution
sections.sql: select rule,finding from record_checks where survey_id=$1

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select revision,reviewer,evidence,created_at from reviews where survey_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Source fields
sections.sql: select source_fields from surveys where id=$1

name: field-return
title: Draft field return brief
for_each: select id,code from surveys order by code

sections.title: Site and method
sections.sql: select code,site,method,evidence_ref from surveys where id=$1

sections.title: Outstanding follow-ups
sections.sql: select code,description,owner,due_on from actions where survey_id=$1 and completed_at is null order by due_on

sections.title: Unresolved record checks
sections.sql: select rule,finding from record_checks where survey_id=$1
